title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 6fbdd13040b4… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 6fbdd13040b4716599a1dca4797b1fbe9b1d1df002ed4ef67147462dd288a39e was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. This file was detected seven times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) from attacker infrastructure located in the Netherlands. The file is associated with a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and security feeds to identify potential compromise.
